checks.detail: 16.7% needed at the extrados; JIS G 3445 does not guarantee elongation for OD <= 40 mm: state a minimum in the purchase specification
checks.source: Pines/Unison: elongation = (OD/2)/CLR; JIS G 3445 Table 3 note a), JIS G 3459 clause 6.1

checks.title: Wall thinning and ovality (estimates)
checks.detail: extrados wall 1.03 mm (14.3% thinner); ovality without a mandrel about 5.0% (typical acceptance 5-8%), lower with one
checks.source: Bend Tooling thinning rule; Tube Form Solutions: ovality = 0.7 x difficulty factor
